## What

One line: what this PR changes and why. Link the issue it closes.

## Evidence

The commands you ran and what they printed. CI compiles the remake but does not run
the game, so a behaviour change needs the local checks from `remake/README.md`
(trace replay, smoke, longrun) — say which were run and what they matched. For
docs-only changes, the grep that proves the claim is the evidence.

Visual work: a screenshot under a `## Screenshot` heading, per `AGENTS.md` §4
(raw URL at the head SHA).

## Closes

Closes #<issue>
